summary: The Jackson3JsonPayloadConverter(JsonMapper) constructor is not visible to javac in Java 17+ projects, even though it's present in META-INF/versions/17/ and works at runtime with maven/gradle builds.
userImpact: Java 17+ developers using Jackson 3 experience IDE compilation errors when using the Jackson3JsonPayloadConverter(JsonMapper) constructor, despite successful gradle/maven builds.
rootCause: The multi-release JAR has the constructor only in META-INF/versions/17/ but javac/IntelliJ is not properly resolving it according to JEP 238 specifications.
workaround: Use gradle/maven builds instead of relying on javac compilation in IDE; these build tools properly resolve the constructor from the multi-release JAR.
keyQuote: running with mvn/gradle is fine, only issue with javac
